The '''Oba Diah moon''', also known as the '''desert moon of Oba Diah''', was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oba Diah/Legends|Oba Diah]], located near [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[775519/Legends|T-6 shuttle]] belonging to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] was shot down to crash on the moon, and circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] found the remnants of the shuttle on the moon.
